SPATTER DASH -> ROUGH PLASTER -> SMOOTH PLASTER -> SIGMA

steel angle / corner beads measured as a separate lm item at exposed plaster edges: door / opening jambs, window edges (incl. below / around where the site method requires), external plastered corners and exposed corners receiving a bead

cornice only where a drawing, ceiling layout, specification or owner / project fact establishes it; geometry known but presence unknown = PENDING / REVIEW, never zero

project drawing / detail > project notes / specification > applicable Kuwait RC code / authority > referenced ACI requirements > recognised detailing / fabrication standard > provisional code method > owner input > BLOCKED

the +1.00 level chain alone does not prove depth; technical DERIVED only when beam top AND bottom are established from section / detail / binding; otherwise PROVISIONAL_SOURCE_DERIVED with the depth assumption explicit

note 18 (slab 16 cm unless stated) is not proof of the waist; search stair section / detail / reinforcement / thickness notation first; otherwise 16 cm is PROVISIONAL_SOURCE_DERIVED / CODE_METHOD candidate, never SOURCE_RULE; risers can still be technical if the section proves them

publish F_SCENARIO, F10_SCENARIO, LOW, HIGH, DIFFERENCE; technical BLOCKED_SOURCE_CONFLICT; commercial PROVISIONAL_SOURCE_RANGE; a selected conservative scenario enters the commercial total only explicitly labelled as the selected commercial basis

DXF topology vs DXF DIMENSION reconstruction is calculation-independent, not source-independent; add a cross-source Route C (arch PDF area sheet, PDF elevation / section, CAD oracle) where possible; report CALCULATION_INDEPENDENCE and SOURCE_INDEPENDENCE separately
